avSummary: dwell 437, inhabitant 221, sit 172, abide 70, inhabit 39, down 26, remain 23, in 22, tarry 19, set 14, continue 5, place 7, still 5, taken 5, misc 23
definition:
1) to dwell, remain, sit, abide
    1a) (Qal)
        1a1) to sit, sit down
        1a2) to be set
        1a3) to remain, stay
        1a4) to dwell, have one's abode
    1b) (Niphal) to be inhabited
    1c) (Piel) to set, place
    1d) (Hiphil)
        1d1) to cause to sit
        1d2) to cause to abide, set
        1d3) to cause to dwell
        1d4) to cause (cities) to be inhabited
        1d5) to marry (give an dwelling to)
    1e) (Hophal)
        1e1) to be inhabited
        1e2) to make to dwell
